questions.text: Vijay invests a sum of ₹5400 and Mohan invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 6 years, Mohan gets ₹600 more interest than Vijay, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).

Four people move along the circumference of a park. They complete one round in 6 minutes, 8 minutes, 10 minutes and 14 minutes, respectively. Since they started together, after how many hours will they meet again at the starting position?
The greatest number, which divides 1163 and 2214 to leave 15 and 82 respectively as remainders, is:
A man’s monthly salary increased from ₹42,000 to ₹57,000. What is the percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) increase in his monthly salary?
Find the total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius 0.07 m. (Use π = 22/7)
The smallest natural number which is divisible by 5, 10, 49 and 28 is:
Tushar sold 150 chairs and had a gain equal to the selling price of 50 chairs. What is his profit percentage?

Rishi has ₹1612 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Shan and Piyush and asked them to invest it at 8% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Shan and Piyush got same amount after 19 and 20 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Rishi give to Shan?

A, B and C working separately can do a piece of work in 5, 8 and 6 days, respectively. If they all work together and earn ₹22,774 for the whole work, then find the difference between the shares of B and C.
A shopkeeper bought an article for ₹500. At what price (in ₹) should he sell the article to make 24% profit?
The LCM of two numbers is 126 times their HCF. If their HCF is 7 and the difference between the two numbers is five times the HCF, then the product of the two numbers is:
The average weight of Anwar, Amit and Gopal is 46 kg. If the average weight of Anwar and Amit be 39 kg and that of Amit and Gopal be 44 kg, then the weight of Amit (in kg) is:

The price of fuel decreases by 40%, 30% and 10% in three successive months, but increases by 40% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹42 and compound interest is ₹63, then what is the principal (in ₹)?
In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rice costing ₹165 and ₹285 per kg, respectively, to get a mixture of rice worth ₹195 per kg?
A train 240 m long is running at a speed of 88 km/h. In what time will it pass a man who is running at a speed of 16 km/h in the same direction?
Find the fourth proportional of 4, 12, and 20.
A pair of articles was bought for ₹1,820 at a discount of 20%, and marked price of each article is same. What is the marked price (in ₹) of an article?
The speed of a stream is 9 km/h. A boat can go 28 km downstream and 20 km upstream in 8 hours. What is the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water?
80 men can construct a small footpath in 100 days. How many more men should be employed if the job is to be finished in 25 days?
